title: Tracked import resolution
responsibility: Resolves a scanned reference to a tracked repository file, external package or explicit uncertainty.

inputs.name: resolveImport.from
inputs.description: Repository-relative importing file path using forward slashes.

inputs.name: resolveImport.reference
inputs.description: Scanned reference with import kind, optional literal specifier, type-only flag and detail for computed references.

inputs.name: resolveImport.context
inputs.description: Tracked path set and owning workspace root for relative and $lib resolution.

outputs.name: resolveImport
outputs.description: Resolved file path, external package/framework name or non-literal/unresolved uncertainty, retaining via and typeOnly. Tries supported extensions, index files and .js-to-.ts fallback; does not read the filesystem.
